finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs hid in the warning noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. It now takes either name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means off, like before.

The other 8 warnings are all deprecation notices. They point at files like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, which this project doesn't have. They come from the bumped packages, so nothing here can silence them.
